message.text: I found the top result: 28 call sites across 14 distinct enclosing methods, all within internal/filter/render.go. Runner-up candidates are Schema.Field with 19, jsonArrayExpr with 16, and the highest cross-package usage is filter.DefaultEngine and util.GenUUID at 7 each -- though I should note this analysis is textual rather than type-aware, so it may miss some nuance.

h10.

**`(*renderer).addArg` — `internal/filter/render.go:842` — approximately 28 call sites (14 distinct calling methods), all inside `internal/filter/render.go`.**

`addArg` is the SQL-argument accumulator in the filter renderer: every place that emits a bound parameter into generated SQL calls it, which is why it dominates. Callers include `renderScalarComparison`, `renderScalarInCondition`, `renderTagEquals`, `renderTagInList`, `renderTagStartsWith`, `renderRegex`, `renderAccessorComparison`, `renderFunctionComparison`, `renderJSONBoolComparison`, `renderElementInCondition`, `elementPredicateSQL`, `foldedLike`, `buildJSONArrayLike`, and `addBoolArg`.

The next-highest declarations under `internal/`, for context:

| Symbol | Path | Approx. call sites |
|---|---|---|
| `(Schema).Field` | `internal/filter/schema.go:67` | 19 (10 in `internal/filter/parser.go`, 9 in `internal/filter/render.go`) |
| `jsonArrayExpr` | `internal/filter/render.go` | 16 (all in the same file) |
| `(*MarkdownRenderer).renderChildren` | `internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go` | 14 (same file) |

Note the winner is package-private and its fan-in is entirely intra-package. If you instead want the most-called *cross-package* symbol declared under `internal/`, that's a tie around 7: `filter.DefaultEngine` (`internal/filter/engine.go`), called from `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go` and the six per-dialect memo/relation files under `store/db/`; and `util.GenUUID` (`internal/util/util.go`), called from six files including `server/auth/token.go`, `server/router/api/v1/auth_service_session.go`, and `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service_storage.go`.

Method of measurement, and its limits: I enumerated every `func` declaration in non-test files under `internal/`, then counted call sites across all non-test Go files in the repo — for package-level functions using import-alias-qualified matching (`pkg.Name(`) plus bare names within the declaring package, and for methods using `.Name(`. This is textual rather than type-aware, so method counts can be inflated when a name is shared with an unrelated type; I filtered those out by hand (for example `.Next()` scored 55 but is overwhelmingly `sql.Rows.Next`, and `.Parse()`/`.Kind()`/`.Validate()` are similarly shared). `addArg`, `Field`, and `renderChildren` are unique names within the analyzed set, so their counts are reliable. Generated code under `proto/gen/` was included in the search but contributes nothing to the top results.
